annotations.text:
SPEC, NOT A REDESIGN
The instruments, panels, honesty rules and every existing control survive untouched. Three additions only:
1. a first-run card (shows once, localStorage, ? brings it back)
2. a guided primary row wrapping the existing buttons - the full strip lives behind ⚙ MORE (the code already groups controls: play / files / capture / cfg)
3. one dim empty-state line per panel
All three are display-layer; no detector, threshold or audio path moves. Harness impact: check-panels empty-state text only.

FIRST RUN CARD
Order is deliberate: HEAR IT NOW first (the demo is the whole product in one press - keeper's words), scan second, skip third. The privacy line is load-bearing copy, not fine print: 'your audio never leaves this machine' is the single biggest thing a cold visitor needs to believe.
Implement: overlay div in the dashboard shadow root; 1 = the existing demo handler, 2 = the existing scan handler, 3 = dismiss. Gate on localStorage dw-seen + empty corpus.

GUIDED ROW MECHANICS
Step state derives from what already exists: corpus.length (scan done), dash.set.length (build done), DW.state.of (playing). The three build modes collapse into ONE select (the buttons already share a handler taking mode). Pink = the one thing to do next; green = done; dim = locked. ⚙ MORE toggles today's rows exactly as ⚙ DISPLAY does now - same mechanism, wider scope.
After first play ever, default to State C on load (returning users are not new users).

OPEN QUESTIONS FOR THE KEEPER
- Does the demo belong in step 1 (pink, primary) or as the side door shown here? The mockup makes it primary on the card, secondary in the row.
- Should ⚙ MORE remember open/closed per browser?
- Phone layout: the guided row is one row - does it replace the phone transport too, or desktop only first?
Edit anything here; artboards are the spec I will implement from.
